changelog: v5.5: drawdown-scaled ceiling on the defensive fraction. Full defensive posture must now be EARNED by real damage: ceiling *= clamp(|drawdown from trailing 1y high| / 0.10, 0, 1). Continuous, not a switch. Fixes an incoherence where Growth could go 100% bonds on a shallow scare while Preserve kept a third in equities (2026-04: SPY +9.7%, Growth +0.6%). Chosen on evidence from all 11 of Growth's 100%-bond episodes 2006-2026: every episode deeper than -8% from the 1y high paid off (7/7, up to +34.7pp in Oct 2008); all three that lost money were shallower. Distance below the 200d SMA does NOT separate them — Mar 2020 was ABOVE its SMA and was a +13.2pp win, because the SMA lags a fast crash. Full cycle: CAGR 19.76%->19.86%, Martin 3.806->3.805 (flat), worst-12mo/worst-3m/maxDD IDENTICAL (crash protection untouched), RDD3y 2.88->2.84 and cohorts-behind 5.54->3.31 (both D6 instruments improve). Apr-2026 +0.58%->+3.97%, YTD +13.17%->+17.00%. Caveat on the record: the benefit is asymmetric across halves (Martin H1 3.578->3.407, H2 4.077->4.312) — it helps more in the recent regime, so this is the one change today that does not improve both halves. Engine: absent config is a no-op, diff:engine byte-identical, scenarios 16/16b pin both directions.
